## Expectation recorded before replay

The DEGRADED share is 3.5% (< 10%): the surface is cliff-like. From the turbofan and simulator sweeps, on a cliff-like surface the ranking should hinge on which strategies' injections cross the cliff for the few prompts where they differ in severity or sensor routing, and should be sensitive to the HIGH multiplier.

This checkpoint also differs from the other two in which channels respond at all: only Xs0, Xs1, Xs2, Xs12 (plus W0/W2 between operating conditions) carry signal, so prompts routed to motor, oil, coolant or electrical sensors can only act through their correlated Xs0/Xs1/Xs2 components.
